transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, thanks for seeing me. When I’m stressed after work and classes, I end up eating way more food in one sitting than seems normal for anyone. It's just gotten to a point where I feel like I really need some help with it.
During these episodes of eating more food than normal, do you feel a lack of control over your eating, like you can't stop once you've started?

Yes, absolutely. Once I start, it feels like a switch flips in my brain and my hand just goes on autopilot, reaching for more food. Even when I'm telling myself to stop because I know I'll feel sick, I just can't seem to make myself do it.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever engage in behaviors like vomiting, laxatives, or excessive exercise to compensate for the calories you consumed?

No, I don't do anything like that. I've never forced myself to throw up, taken laxatives, or tried to exercise excessively to make up for what I ate. I just end up sitting there with the physical discomfort and feeling incredibly guilty.
How often do you experience these episodes of eating large amounts of food in a short time, feeling a lack of control and guilt afterwards?

Looking back at my calendar over the last few months, there hasn't been a single week where I haven't had at least one of these episodes. It happens at least once a week, sometimes more, where I order way too much food and just eat until I feel completely sick.
Can you describe how often you experience feelings of guilt or shame after these episodes, and does this emotional response affect your daily life or relationships in any way?

I feel an overwhelming amount of shame and embarrassment after every single episode, which has led me to hide my eating from my roommates and eat alone in my room. It's really taken a toll on my life—I've started skipping salsa nights and turning down friends, and I even call in sick to work or skip classes because I feel too drained and ashamed to face anyone.
Have you noticed any significant weight fluctuations or concerns about your weight that contribute to your feelings of guilt or shame after these episodes?

I haven't really noticed any significant weight changes, and I don't think about my weight all that much. The intense guilt and shame I feel are really just driven by how completely out of control the eating behavior itself feels.
Have you experienced any issues with sexual desire, arousal, or performance that seem to coincide with your eating episodes or overall stress levels?
No, I haven't really noticed or experienced any issues with my sexual desire or performance. That hasn't been a part of my current struggles at all.
Can you estimate how many episodes of binge eating you experience in a typical month, and how long each episode usually lasts?

It happens most nights after work and classes, so probably around 15 to 20 times a month over the last four months. I'm not really sure exactly how many minutes or hours each individual episode lasts, though. It just seems to take up a significant portion of my unscheduled evenings alone in my apartment.
